thread:
Alex (sales): Oracore requested a short perf POC next week. Mixed traffic: embeddings-heavy + chat-gen + retrieval. They need sustained 250 RPS and frequent short spikes (2m) to 2000 RPS every ~90m. Ask: runbook + rough cost + security blurb.
Ravi (eng): Two clarifying q's: exact spike duration and cooldown? Also multi-AZ requirement?
Alex (sales): Spikes ~2 minutes, cooldown ~8 minutes. Yes multi-AZ failover required. SLOs: embeddings p95 < 180ms, chat-gen token p99 < 450ms if we can.
Tina (eng-ml): Immediate recommendations: Dedicated cluster, embeddings quantized to 4-bit, prefix/KV caching for chat, and model-variant fallback for spikes. Prewarm KV and model shards before spike windows.
Liam (eng-sre): Ops reminder: multi-AZ active/standby adds routing hops ~20-50ms. Need to reserve network headroom and make sure autoscaler can borrow burst capacity without throttling.
Ravi (eng): Draft runbook: 1) 3m ramp warmup to 250 RPS; 2) sustain 30m @250 RPS; 3) three spike runs: 2m @2000 RPS with 8m cooldown; 4) failover test (promote standby). Use vegeta to shape traffic. Example commands:
```bash
vegeta attack -rate=250 -duration=30m -targets=mix_targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > sustained.json
vegeta attack -rate=2000 -duration=2m -targets=spike_targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > spike1.json
```
Ravi (eng): Traffic mix: embeddings:chat:retrieval = 5:1:1. Include 60s gradual ramp for spikes.
perf-bot: Lab dry-run (250 RPS sustain): embeddings p50=80ms p95=172ms p99=290ms. Gen token latencies p95=360ms p99=540ms. Spike (2000 RPS): embeddings p95=620ms p99=1400ms; gen token p95=980ms p99=1800ms. KV prewarm test reduced embeddings p99 on spike by ~38%. CSV attached (simulated data).
Tina (eng-ml): Notes: major spike tail drivers are KV-cache misses and temporary shard contention. Mitigations that work: KV prewarm, prefix caching, and pinned lighter-model fallback for burst window. Expected gen p99 under these mitigations ~ <700ms in most cases.
Liam (eng-sre): Security snippet for Oracore questionnaire: private deployment supports customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK), disk encryption with CMK, TLS 1.2+ with mTLS options for connectors, audit logs exportable to customer SIEM, SOC2 compliance and routine pentests. We'll fill their form with specifics.
Alex (sales): Pricing: Oracore asked for 1-month POC estimate and 3-month commit discount.
Ravi (eng): Ballpark estimate: 10x A100-equivalent dedicated nodes + burst buffer ~ $45k	65k for 1 month on on-demand; 3-month commit discount typically ~20% (final after pricing team sign-off).
Alex (sales): Next steps: book a 2-hour session (sustain + one spike + failover). Ravi to prepare a 1-page results summary + appendix (vegeta commands, prometheus queries, p95/p99 tables, quick cost calc). I9ll send Oracore calendar invite and attach their security questionnaire. Thanks.
Ravi (eng): Will prepare results JSON like: { "sustained": "rps=250 p95=172 p99=290", "spike": "rps=2000 p95=620 p99=1400", "notes": "KV prewarm reduces p99 ~38%" } and a short ops appendix.
Alex (sales): Great. Please post final runbook and a compact slide for the customer after the run.
